posts.author: kuromeku
posts.title: Banned for... resisting against an admin's faction.
posts.html:
So I spent an hour getting a group of five people, getting resistance vests, glocks, radios, zip ties, ammo, etc. We called ourself Liberation. Fighting against Legion (who rob, mug and kill people who have just started playing the game). I thought, well fine if Legion are gonna be like that I'll start a resistance.

So, we do what they do against them, we get our equipment and we go out together and kill three legion citizens. Five minutes later: kicked and banned.

Kicked and banned for resisting against the faction that pisses everyone off.

Discuss.

Firstly, can I ask why you are attempting to guess our member's passwords?



You probably reversed the encryption on the passwords we used on your forum, but it is entirely unnecessary and rather pointless. All this over a roleplay server? Jeez...

You were banned following the reported threats you made to the members of this forum and community online this morning, nothing to do with the action taken in game - its great when somebody takes out Legion, allows those of us not in the clan to have a bit more freedom.

Now lets keep to our respective communities - we have never entered your community in a negative or malicious way, and we do not plan on doing so in future. Its best to handle things diplomatically rather than maliciously.

Discuss.

-KiZai
